Confirms path-k rests on a real vacatur-and-expungement mechanism.
operatorConfirmation.standing: Operator-supplied substantive confirmation. Resolves the legal-research unknown and re-scopes this blocker to byte transfer only. NOT final authority for the receipt: the receipt's verified authority, operative span, currentness and support verdict fill only from the served official bytes, and E must still compare the compiled pathway's eligible-offense list, consent requirement and participant treatment against the exact statute text.
